## Checklist

- [ ] PR title is a Conventional Commit; branch follows `<type>/<issue#>-<slug>`
- [ ] Lint, format, type check and tests pass locally (once tooling exists)
- [ ] Tests added/updated for changed behavior (or explained why not)
- [ ] Docs updated in this PR where behavior, schemas, commands or decisions changed
- [ ] `docs/project/status.md` updated if project state changed
- [ ] No data, media, secrets or real chat usernames in the diff
- [ ] Schema / label / metric changes include an ADR (or N/A)
- [ ] New dependencies are justified below (or N/A)

## AI assistance

<!-- Not a judgment: it helps reviewers focus. -->

- [ ] No AI assistance
- [ ] AI-assisted (agent wrote some code/docs; I reviewed every line)
- [ ] Mostly AI-generated (I verified behavior as described above)

<!-- Optional: which areas the agent wrote, and anything a reviewer should scrutinize. -->
